# viettelcloud_project_member_roles (Data Source)

Get the IAM roles of a human member of the project by username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the roles of a project member by exact username.
data "viettelcloud_project_member_roles" "example" {
  username = "alice"
}

output "alice_role_urns" {
  value = [for assignment in data.viettelcloud_project_member_roles.example.assignments : assignment.urn]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `username` (String) Username of the member to look up. Outer whitespace is ignored; the rest must match exactly, including case.

### Read-Only

- `assignments` (Attributes List) Role assignments with role details, sorted by URN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the member joined the project (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Project member ID (UUID).
- `member_email` (String) Email of the member. It can be empty.
- `member_is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the member is a project admin.
- `member_user_id` (String) User ID (UUID) of the member.
- `roles` (Attributes Set) Role assignments of the member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the member was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the role.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the assignment is enabled.
- `id` (String) Assignment ID (UUID).
- `role_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the role itself is enabled.
- `type` (String) Role type: predefined or custom.
- `urn` (String) URN of the role.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the assignment is enabled.
- `role_urn` (String) URN of the role.
